propositions: Three verifier code paths select the verifier model via an equality test against the default model, so any non-default (e.g. Bedrock or provider-qualified) id is read as an operator override and the downgrade silently stops applying.
code-review.yaml declares no model on its steps so its passes never downgrade, and Pass-2 loses determinism when run on the frontier model.
The fix introduces a single resolve_model_string function that resolves reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) and returns any other string unchanged, called from all verifier call sites.
Workflow steps name a model class by using the reserved class name as the model value with no new schema key, and literal model ids must resolve byte-for-byte unchanged for back-compat.

A defect remains: resolve_class always emits a provider-qualified id, so with no class configured the verifier model string changes form (bare claude-sonnet-4-6 becomes anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6), breaking the promised byte-identical output.
The explicit-operator-override contract is intentionally removed under classes, so the test pinning the old rule must be updated with justification rather than fixed silently.
